contests.title: Black River Falls School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote: BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of School District of Black River Falls, Jackson, Clark, and Monroe Counties, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,000,000 per year for four years, beginning with the 2026-2027 school year ending with the 2029-2030 school year, for non-recurring purposees consisting of operational expenses, including to maintain class sizes and educational programs, transportation costs, and to address staff salaries and benefits.

contests.title: Brillion School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote: BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the Brillion Public School District, Calumet, Manitowoc and Brown Counties, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,000,000 per year for five years, beginning with the 2026-2027 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of expenses to maintain educational programs and services, pay staff compensation, update technology, and building maintenance costs.

contests.title: Delavan-Darien School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote: BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the School District of Delavan-Darien, Walworth and Rock Counties, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $5,500,000 per year for four years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of operational expenses, including student academic resources, co-curricular programming, employ School Resource Officers, and staff salaries and benefits.

contests.title: Elmbrook School District — School improvement bonds

provenance.quote:
BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the School District of Elmbrook, Waukesha
County, Wisconsin that there shall be issued pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin Statutes,
general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $100,000,000 for the public purpose of
paying the cost of a school facility improvement project at Pilgrim Park Middle School,
Tonawanda Elementary School, Swanson Elementary School and Wisconsin Hills Middle
School consisting of: renovations, accessibility updates, building infrastructure and site
improvements; construction of additions at Pilgrim Park Middle School; construction of an
addition at Tonawanda Elementary School; and acquisition of furnishings, fixtures and
equipment.

contests.title: Luxemburg-Casco School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise $1 million a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for four school years, from 2026–27 through 2029–30. It would pay for operations, including class sizes, educational programs, transportation, and employee salaries and benefits. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $1 million a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for five school years, from 2026–27 through 2030–31. It would pay for educational programs and services, employee compensation, technology updates, and building maintenance. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $5.5 million a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for four school years, from 2027–28 through 2030–31. It would pay for operations, including student academic resources, activities outside regular classes, school resource officers, and employee salaries and benefits. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to borrow up to $100 million through general obligation bonds for renovations, accessibility improvements, infrastructure and school-site work at Pilgrim Park Middle, Tonawanda Elementary, Swanson Elementary, and Wisconsin Hills Middle schools. The project also includes additions at Pilgrim Park and Tonawanda, plus furnishings, fixtures and equipment.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve borrowing up to $100 million for these projects.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise $7.1 million a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit, beginning in the 2027–28 school year, for operations and maintenance. This increase is ongoing and has no scheduled end date.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the ongoing annual revenue-limit increase.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise money above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for four school years: $18.5 million in 2027–28, $22.5 million in 2028–29, $26.5 million in 2029–30, and $30.5 million in 2030–31. The money is for maintaining class sizes, student program options and services. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $1.8 million a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for three school years, from 2027–28 through 2029–30. It would pay for operations, including employee compensation and benefits and reading, math, college and technical-career programs. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise money above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for four school years: $24.9 million in 2027–28, $27.9 million in 2028–29, $31.1 million in 2029–30, and $34.6 million in 2030–31. The money is for educational and extracurricular programs, employee compensation, and other operations. This temporary authorization ends after those years.
